comparison.objective: Meter a hydraulic valve to lower a fragile cabinet gently onto rails; candidate breaks insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous valve modulation and load-speed control versus discrete hammer impulse control while maintaining mandrel coaxiality.
comparison.success_condition: Cabinet transfers to stable rail support with acceptable landing speed and no glass contact; exact failure thresholds beyond the reported landing are absent. Candidate requires four fractures, containment, and no insert or shell damage.
comparison.reason: Both regulate force-related motion, but one tests controlled lowering through a valve and the other tests localized notch fracture plus debris recovery.
